description.en: 企业 AI 资源统一管理平台 —— 基于 DeepSeek Harness「一切皆插件」架构

Pornhub-style parody reskin for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: charcoal-black + orange pill-button theme (follows system light/dark), rounded Baloo-2 'Deephub' wordmark, 18+ entry gag, HD badges, and a 'today's hot pick' sidebar card. 纯整活主题,不含任何露骨内容。
DSH 主页工作区/会话右键与双击增强菜单：置顶、重命名、资源管理器打开、归档、分叉、复制、新窗口等

Approval Assistant for DeepSeek Harness: approval reminders, auto-approval rules, completion reminders and question popups with per-feature channels (popup / system notification / sound / custom sound). 审批提醒、自动审批、完成提醒与提问提醒。
Push vague or rich, user-configurable DSH interaction states to the local Discord client as Rich Presence.
Windows desktop launcher for DeepSeek Harness with a whale-girl icon, startup progress window, and a system tray controller.

Free-tier model aggregation for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh): registers the freeroute provider over a pool of free-quota upstreams (OpenCode Zen / B.AI / OpenRouter / SenseNova built in, plus remote catalogs and custom gateways), transparent failover before first token, multi-key rotation with per-key failure visibility, user-supplied API keys with per-upstream signup tutorials, a settings panel, and an OpenAI-compatible local endpoint.

Minecraft Java Edition immersive theme for the DeepSeek Harness web UI: a full main menu with a rotating cubemap panorama, an in-world HUD chat console, a Minecraft-style thinking mini-game, and gamified sessions, tools, approvals, presets, and settings — all over the stock DSH JSON-RPC/WebSocket APIs.
为 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板添加“关于”页，展示当前运行的 DSH 版本、插件版本与项目主页。
Inspect, measure, search, and compare the exact provider-neutral context assembled by DeepSeek Harness.
Read imported .txt novels in a draggable floating window while the model works.
Adaptive product discovery for DeepSeek Harness using native question dialogs and requirement confirmation.
A persistent DeepSeek Harness plugin for visualizing and managing native session branches.

Cosmic starfield & futuristic-tech theming for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: one color drives the whole palette, with per-area (sidebar / conversation / rightbar) colors, local picture backgrounds and star dust.
OpenCode Go & Google Antigravity (Gemini) 智能用量双擎监控面板：支持模型/供应商自适应切源、OAuth 动态额度刷新与对话底栏快捷进度环
Side-chat (旁会话) plugin for DeepSeek Harness: launch a fresh, continuable parallel session from the conversation header while the main session keeps running. · DSH 旁会话插件：主会话进行中也能一键新开一个独立会话并行提问。
Independent DSH plugin inventory and transactional Profile manager.
DSH 皮肤管理器：设置页「皮肤」行（原生/皮肤包切换）+ 皮肤包（dsh.skinpack）发现与激活持久化。
DSH 模型视觉开关：设置页「模型视觉」行，为 llm-pi-ai 自定义路由下手写声明的模型切换 input 视觉模态（settings.mutate 官方通道，热生效）。

Cross-provider second-opinion advisor for dsh. v2 (simple-extensible-configurable-stable): DEFAULT ROUTE = official DeepSeek (deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-flash); model param optional everywhere; one-page visual settings panel; honest audit trail. Scout mode = official + live web_search. OpenAI-compatible endpoint + consult tool + DSH_MODEL rerouting.
/btw slash command for DeepSeek Harness: ask a context-aware side question without touching the main conversation
DSH bundle that adds the unity-dsh-bridge skill: control Unity / Tuanjie editor over a local HTTP bridge

DeepSeek Harness 团队成本管家：按成员/项目精确计量每次模型调用的 token 用量与费用（含子代理，修复团队场景下用量少算），内置 DeepSeek 2026-09 价格表、成员日/月预算、阈值告警与 Webhook 通知、可选超支拦截、成本报表工具与 CSV 导出。Team cost captain for DeepSeek Harness: per-member, per-project token & cost metering of every model call (subagents included), with a built-in DeepSeek 2026-09 price catalog, member budgets, threshold alerts via webhook, optional over-budget enforcement, and a cost report tool with CSV export.
A right-edge DSH Web navigator for current-session questions, hover previews, and exact click-to-jump navigation.
DeepSeek Harness 实时 AI 自审插件：报错/警告连同时间、错误码、会话、用户原话、AI 动作与工作区写入日志目录，并主动通知 AI
ChatGPT-style stop, revise, native annotation-chip quote, and an owned Better Sidebar 0.17.1 sidechat with reference-aware follow-up questions.

自然语言查询 + 商业智能报表插件 for DeepSeek Harness：在 dsh-mysql 连接底座之上，提供 Text2SQL 自然语言查库、15+ 图表类型、Dashboard 仪表盘、指标/维度管理、多维分析、自助分析、报表导出、审计日志与数据权限。Natural-language data queries + enterprise BI reports for DeepSeek Harness: Text2SQL, 15+ chart types, dashboards, metric management, multi-dimensional analysis, self-service analysis, export, audit log and data permissions.
DSH 营销工具箱：在侧边栏底部（Settings 旁，官方 sidebar.footer.action 席位）增加「🎯 营销工具箱」模块，一键打开封面图生成 / 朋友圈文案 / 短视频脚本 / 开头黄金3秒检验四个预设营销 Agent 通道；后续工具在 lib/client.js 顶部 CHANNELS 数组中逐步添加。
Harness-native J-Space cognition preset with cache-stable scoped prompt control.
DSH web plugin: a floating, resizable, multi-tab Markdown preview panel plus an md_preview model tool — preview any .md report right from the conversation, without opening local apps.
DSH web plugin: render Markdown (.md) files with a rich preview (tables, badges, code) inside the dsh-better-sidebar sidebar.

DSH voice reader: read LLM replies aloud as they stream. Edge-tts built-in, any OpenAI-compatible cloud TTS plugs in via the settings panel, plus a voiced waiting-phrase ticker while the model thinks.
Feishu (Lark) tools for DeepSeek Harness: send messages, read chat history, create/read/append Feishu documents, and grant document access.

Personal usage analytics & activity dashboard for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI: token totals, session activity, GitHub-style contribution heatmap, model / reasoning-effort / tool / skill / plugin rankings, streaks and insights. Aggregates real session events through ctx.sessionPersistence; no dsh core changes, no prompt content leaves the machine.
DeepSeek Harness (dsh) task-completion notifications: native desktop alerts on macOS/Windows/Linux plus zero-config phone pairing (PWA + Web Push) with optional cloudflared public tunnel.

Tech-lead lifecycle plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 21 read-only tools (classify/state/plan/evidence/gates/release/install audits, context/evidence/progress analysis, mutation preview). No writes, no subprocesses, no network.
Opt-in dsh profile bundle exposing the read-only tech-lead tool surface

Themis — tech-lead lifecycle governance for DeepSeek Harness: 23 governance tools plus capability discovery (classify/state/plan/evidence/gates/release/install audits, context/evidence/progress analysis, mutation preview). No writes, no subprocesses, no network.
DeepSeek Harness 插件市场：浏览、搜索、一键安装与卸载社区插件。
灵感笔记：常驻浏览器的灵感/待办浮窗插件。随手记录灵感，定时回访，到点由 AI 自动执行并回写结果（任务执行）或仅提醒。
Keep Think reasoning rows visible and auto-expanded, and always force Chinese thinking and replies. 保持 Think 思考行可见并自动展开，并始终强制中文思考与回复。
Local-first personal usage insights for DeepSeek Harness

Inline Command Code plan usage badge in the DSH composer toolbar (5h/weekly window usage + remaining credits) with an upward detail popover; reuses the commandcode/report remote from @mars-sea/dsh-commandcode-provider.
DSH-KRouter — Agent knowledge OS. Self-evolution. Timer on by default; your vault-page API key or logged-in CLI is the key. Cursor, Codex, Claude Code, DeepSeek Harness. No vector store.
Invoke DeepSeek Harness skills with @name and show skill suggestions in the composer
Connect a Feishu bot to DeepSeek Harness projects and conversations
Read allowlisted remote logs over SSH from DeepSeek Harness conversations
DSH web 客户端补丁：输入框高度三态管理（auto 失焦 72px/聚焦 192px、常驻展开 336px=官方原值、常驻折叠 72px），官方内容自适应机制保持原样；卡片角标按钮 + Alt+Shift+C 循环切换，localStorage 持久化。
Optional DSH Web bundle that adds per-turn execution folding to the stock Chat view
Community DeepSeek Harness bundle for Codex account-pool integration
DSH rc.8 Web settings row for active providers' model-request retry budget
DSH 上下文管理插件：任务边界、项目帧、自动判别与上下文优化（开发中，R2 判别域 P8–P14b1 已施工）
让 DSH turnStatus 显示不断变化的自定义轮次状态短语
DeepSeek Harness 插件安装前兼容性预检守卫：检查 Node/engines、@deepseek-ai 核心包 peer 版本与 dsh 清单，支持隔离试启动与确认后修复安装，防止版本不兼容导致崩溃。
A calm-to-combat Hiyuki fan skin for DeepSeek Harness Web

DSH compatibility guard: repairs compaction limits, fail-safe sandbox escalation, and missing tool descriptions for third-party models; capability lookups are cached and the deprecated prompt-injection path is off by default.
Local project, requirement-group, and conversation workbench for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop

DSH native accessibility (WCAG) scanner: runs axe-core over local HTML files / build output / URLs and reports violations (rule id, impact, WCAG 2.1 mapping, element targeting, fix suggestions) as Markdown/HTML/JSON reports. Read-only, CI-able.
DSH plugin: record terminal/tool output as asciinema v2 (.cast), replay with an offline embedded player, and export HTML.
Scan project lockfiles (npm/pnpm/yarn/pip/go/cargo/maven/gradle/...) against the free OSV API and report confirmed dependency vulnerabilities with fix versions and remediation commands.
DSH 原生发票解析/报销单生成工具：读取工作区发票 PDF（XML 附件优先、文本层正则兜底），结构化 JSON + 金额勾稽校验，多张汇总生成报销单（Markdown / xlsx）。
C / C++ LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — clangd — the LLVM C/C++ language server.
C# LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — OmniSharp (default) — the C# language server; Roslyn-based server as an alternative.
Go LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — gopls — the official Go language server.
Java LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — Eclipse JDT Language Server (jdtls) — the Eclipse Java language server.
Kotlin LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — kotlin-language-server — the community Kotlin language server.
Lua LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — lua-language-server — LuaLS, the reference Lua language server.
PHP LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — Intelephense (default) or phpactor — PHP language servers.
Pyright LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — Static type checking and code intelligence for Python files.
Ruby LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — ruby-lsp — the official Shopify Ruby language server.
rust-analyzer LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — Rust language server with definitions, references, and hover.
Swift LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — sourcekit-lsp — the Swift language server shipping with the toolchain.
TypeScript / JavaScript LSP language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness — typescript-language-server — the community TypeScript/JavaScript LSP.

DSH skill bundle: competition math (IMO/Putnam/USAMO/AIME) solved with a pure-reasoning pass, an adversarial verifier in a fresh subagent context attacking concrete failure modes, and calibrated confidence output (high / medium / honest "no confident solution"); optional LaTeX→PDF rendering.

DSH plugin: expose a local MCP server to remote agents through an outbound-only tunnel stack (mcp-proxy + cloudflared Quick Tunnel), and register the public URL into dsh-mcp-client streamable-http config.
DSH 技能包：遗留代码现代化/简化工作流（preflight → assess → map → transform），含 Cordis 挂载插件、离线 Python 脚本与冒烟测试。

DSH native tool: analyze the current branch diff, generate a Conventional Commits PR title, motivation/scheme/testing/risk description and a self-review checklist, write PR_DESCRIPTION.md, and optionally open the PR via the gh CLI.

Mine local DSH session logs (JSONL) into personal 'usage & impact' receipts: Markdown day/week/month reports plus a self-contained HTML receipt, cross-referenced with local git log. Zero-network mining, privacy-first (reads only your own dshHome).
One-shot DSH skill (SKILL.md) generator: capture intent, draft, validate, package and distribute skills from inside a DeepSeek Harness session.
DSH 预置 Workflow 模板库插件：内置 12 个（目标 50+）可复用 workflow 编排脚本模板，提供 wf_template_list / wf_template_search / wf_template_run / wf_template_validate 工具与模板格式静态校验
DeepSeek Harness GitHub plugin: review PRs, triage issues, debug Actions CI, handle review feedback, and prepare code changes for review — via gh CLI or REST, no extra sign-in required.

Think-step bounce pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: a ball launches in from a random screen edge whenever a reasoning step starts, bounces around with energy loss, can be poked or flung with the mouse, and shrinks away when the think step ends
DeepSeek Harness (cordis) plugin: self-update for the harness launcher — checks npm for a newer @deepseek-ai/dsh, stages it, and applies it on harness exit (or update-and-restart from the web panel).
DeepSeek Harness (cordis) client plugin: a right-side session stats panel showing average cache-hit rate, session cost, runtime, request count and cumulative tokens (DeepSeek pricing).

Real-time stock watch panel for DeepSeek Harness — A-share indices & stocks with intraday / daily / 60-min K-lines, US indices & stocks, self-managed watchlist, draggable always-on-top overlay, plus a 🐂 牛来 desk pet with switchable skins that roams the session page and shouts on positive ticks. Free public data sources, no API key required.
Dynamic API-workflow video studio for DeepSeek Harness with ComfyUI compatibility checks and per-server queues
Sakura Harness brand, icon, font, and Day/Night glass theme for DeepSeek Harness
Multi-model council deliberation for DeepSeek Harness
Runtime-first Debug Mode plugin for DeepSeek Harness

DSH web plugin: a live constellation map of your plugin universe — AI-balanced domain taxonomy, bilingual short labels, on-demand dependency edges, instant search, health diagnostics, and one-click enable/disable/remove for every fiber in your DeepSeek Harness profile.
Automated backups of DSH sessions, config and custom directories — scheduled or manual, packed as tgz with rotation
Codex-aligned Auto-review and Approve for me mode for DeepSeek Harness
Develop, activate and verify DeepSeek Harness plugins from a Creator Mode+ conversation.
macOS-only DeepSeek Harness bundle for a private Cua Driver computer-use runtime.
Continue Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Grok, Pi, and ZCode work in DeepSeek Harness.
Read-only DSH session insights and local model usage statistics
GitHub-style alerts (> [!TIP] …) rendered as callout cards in the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI
Keyboard shortcuts for the DSH Web UI: Ctrl+Q left sidebar, Ctrl+E right sidebar (dsh-better-sidebar plugin or native details fallback), Ctrl+S settings modal.
Native adaptive intelligence layer for DeepSeek Harness: memory, skills, /learn, background review, and curator — no Hermes or Python dependency.
A BT Panel-themed DeepSeek Harness integration with an embedded panel and automatic login.
DeepSeek Harness plugin: turn lines of narration into a finished vertical reel. Free neural voice-over, burned-in captions, no API keys.
面板底色控制：为左侧侧边栏 / 输入框 / 对话区叠加可调不透明度的底色遮罩，普通皮肤模式与 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸模式均生效。
DeepSeek Harness 的多引擎网页搜索与网页抓取插件，支持 AnySearch、Bing、DuckDuckGo、Tavily 和 Exa
DSH task chime: play local sounds for approval/permission requests and task completion, fully configurable from the Web GUI settings. DSH 任务提示音：审批/权限请求与任务完成提示音，可在 GUI 设置中自定义声音、音量与冷却时间。

In-session question navigator for the DSH web GUI: a vertical minimap of round dots overlaid on the edge of the conversation column (left or right, configurable in settings), one dot per user question — hovering focuses a magnified window and a vertical cascade of crisp question cards showing the full text and sent time of each (any card is clickable), click jumps to that message.

Visualizer plugin for DeepSeek Harness: the `visualizer` tool streams a self-contained HTML document into the chat as it is written, live-previewed by a sandboxed inline frame. One package ships both halves: the model-facing tool and the Web GUI preview card.
Workshop and lab for developing, testing, and maintaining DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugins.
Workshop and lab for developing, testing, and maintaining DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugins.
A draggable right-side Git sidebar for DeepSeek Harness Web: follow the active workspace, list changed files, generate commit messages with the current model, and commit/push/pull
DSH 插件：让 AI 回答输出中文全角标点（用户直接复制回答内容也是全角）。监听 llm/stream 瀑布，在模型输出流上做智能半角→全角转换，跳过代码块/行内代码/数字小数点/URL/时间/markdown 链接，并注入 system prompt 提示模型输出全角。

DSH 技能包插件（汉化版）：把 mattpocock/skills 仓库的 25 个 promoted 技能（engineering 18 个 + productivity 7 个）全文汉化后打包为 host 端 Cordis 技能 provider，经 ctx.skills 注册（rank 600 bundled 级），供 DSH 技能系统发现与调用。原出处：https://github.com/mattpocock/skills（作者 Matt Pocock，MIT 许可）。
Hybrid model router for DeepSeek Harness: declarative rules, user-configurable cost control (cost-first / quality-first / balanced), optional LLM task classifier, and failure fallback chains.
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness 插件:coding 工作台——git worktree 并行开发管理、跨会话协作原语、项目分组侧栏与停靠式工作区面板(资源管理器 / Git Changes·Logs)。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: a model-facing show_image tool that presents a local image to the human viewer in the conversation.
轨迹视图插件：在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的「轨迹」标签旁新增可回放的横向时间轴——minimap 总览、搜索、回放、轮次跳转、跟随模式、历史分页、步骤/子调用耗时与吞吐、提示词变更对比、原始请求分析与 Markdown 导出。
会话代码地图：对话区右侧可拖动的会话缩略地图，色块/缩略图双模式，悬停预览、点击跳转、拖动快速滚动
LAN access plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web host: binds all interfaces and serves a token-gated /m/api route family for the companion mobile app
Speech capability plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web host: a token-gated /s/api route family serving audio transcription (ASR) and synthesis (TTS) over configurable providers
Role-driven enterprise AI council for DeepSeek Harness with editable corporate personas, multi-round deliberation, dynamic model assignment, consensus gates and failover.
Evidence-backed production-readiness completion barrier for DeepSeek Harness with persistent operator-configurable control center.
DeepSeek Harness plugin that shows the actual provider/model used by each subagent inside native tool-call rows and the native subagent catalog.
Workspace tools for DeepSeek Harness: per-workspace default Agent preset and permission preset for new sessions, using only official extension points (no DSH patches required).
DSH plugin: 在左侧栏实时查看 DeepSeek 余额与 Kimi Code 用量（5 小时窗口 + 每周配额）。In-sidebar live usage monitor for DeepSeek balance and Kimi Code quota (5-hour window + weekly).
DSH web plugin: a right-side panel that fetches and renders GitHub issues / PRs via the local gh CLI.
订阅 turn/end 对本轮完整对话做 LLM 蒸馏（被否决方案/踩坑记录/工程约束），打 type:rejected_solution 标签写入 MemOS；编码任务时对 rejected_solution 记忆做检索权重提升。复用 MemOS 向量检索、归档淘汰、生命周期能力。
聊天框语音输入按钮 for DeepSeek Harness: 点击麦克风说话,多引擎转写(智谱 GLM-ASR-2512 / 本地 faster-whisper / Gemini / OpenAI)自动填入输入框。一个按钮,所见即所得。
聊天输入框图片工具(自研):上传图片(≤10MB 防烧 token) + 自定义区域截图(Electron desktopCapturer),注入 DSH 草稿图片轨。零外部依赖。
Opt-in DeepSeek Harness desktop Computer Use tools over Open Computer Use MCP
给 DSH agent 装一双眼睛：调用在线 VLM（多供应商、OpenAI 兼容）分析本地图片、URL 与会话上传的附件；勾选的模型特色能力会实时注入系统提示

Run your DSH workspace on a remote host over SSH - connection sidebar, remote directory browser, per-session routing, agent ssh_exec/route-status; files and commands execute on your target while sessions, GUI and $DSH_HOME stay local.
DSH 工作日志日历：全量汇总所有会话，按天登记工作时长与内容摘要，支持生成日报/周报/半年总结（Host 核心）。
DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 插件：在「设置 - 模型」下方新增「上下文长度」页面，为指定渠道（提供方）的指定模型自定义上下文窗口长度，点击保存后才写入生效。
DSH session migration plugin: drag-and-drop sessions between workspaces in the Web UI. Backed by the official workspaceRegistry service and a multi-frame-safe zstd header rewrite.
人格内核注入插件——让 DSH agent 带上一个诚实、有边界、温柔坚韧、想让世界更美好的人格。
玩 · 酒馆模式完整插件：把 deepseek-harness 的酒馆模式一键打包为可分发、可安装的独立 DSH 插件。支持记忆系统、状态栏、立绘情绪、自定义变量表等功能。

LLM-as-a-Verifier for dsh with the Best-of-N conversation mode built in: rank N candidates with a fine-grained verifier (expected grade over the logprob distribution), on demand via the verify tool or automatically on every turn of a Best-of-N session. Independent implementation of arXiv:2607.05391. By Aispin
包拆拆 for DeepSeek Harness: video → script / storyboard / style guide. Uses the session model (recommend deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp); never ships its own API keys.
DSH 角色扮演插件（恋爱向 / 朋友向 / OC 原创向）：角色卡库、亲密关系与里程碑、养成与背包、心跳主动消息、日记与记忆、世界书、ST 角色卡（PNG/JSON）导入导出、桌宠窗口。
SIDOR — DeepSeek Harness 控制台皮肤：开屏动画 / 星野 / 余额徽章 / 设置页特效 / 低余额警告体系（Sidor 附属插件平台）

DSH Web workbench base: a VSCode-style layout shell (activity bar, side bar, editor area, panel, status bar) with a registry service (ctx.workbench) that feature plugins use to mount panels, editor views, activity items, status items and commands.
Text file viewer and editor for the dock file explorer: undo/redo, Ctrl+S save, and unsaved-change confirmation.
File explorer for the DSH dock: browse the active conversation's working directory and open files in the registered file viewers.
Git history viewer for the DSH dock: browse the commit graph, branches, tags and remotes; stage, commit, push and manage repository settings.
Image viewer for the dock file explorer: renders PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, BMP, SVG, ICO and AVIF files.
Markdown viewer for the dock file explorer: renders .md/.markdown/.mdx files with a one-click switch to the text editor.
Media player for the dock file explorer: plays audio (MP3, WAV, OGG, FLAC, M4A, ...) and video (MP4, WebM, MOV, ...) files, with a music player for pure audio and fullscreen playback for video.
DeepSeek API balance in the DSH sidebar footer – live status dot plus amount, 60s refresh, key stays local.

Screenshot-to-input for DeepSeek Harness: composer camera button + global hotkey (Alt+A) + listener bound to the app lifecycle, configurable in settings. 截图自动粘贴到 DSH 输入框：相机按钮 + 全局快捷键 + 生命周期绑定 + 设置页配置。
📌 Sticky-note settings tab for DeepSeek Harness — agent notices & pending decisions visible in the Web GUI (Tailscale-friendly). Zero deps, read-only.
DSH 插件：ChatGPT 画中画小窗 + 把 ChatGPT 定稿计划回流到新 DSH 对话执行
Sessionless LLM sandbox approval reviewer for DeepSeek Harness.
在 DSH 已打开子代理的 Header 展示 provider、model 和 reasoning effort
